about_the_game:
Be a cat. Climb everything. Find calm in a witch’s cozy home.

MeCat VR is a cozy VR game with light platforming. You play as a magical cat in a fantasy world, no HUD, no text and no danger. Explore a warm home and moonlit courtyard, bat objects off shelves, and parkour up a giant tree into the clouds. Natural, hand-driven controls keep everything intuitive and language-free.

What you’ll do

  • Explore and discover the mysteries of the Witch.

  • Find and complete the scattered Altars.

  • Complete Puzzles and unlock powers.

  • Walk, climb and jump, all with Hand-Driven Movements.

  • Break objects, open drawers and move objects with natural interactions.

  • Complete The Ritual and follow the Witch.

🐾 And most importantly, enjoy the experience and have fun! 🐾

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 equivalent or greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290 or greater
  • Storage: 2 GB available space MB available space
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 2/3, OpenXR on SteamVR with Index (probably)
  • Additional Notes: VR Only, Standing or Seated
